name: agent-bus-plugins
description: Local message bus for AI agent-to-agent communication. Bundles the agent-bus MCP server (42 tools), the universal coordinator skill, /main and /listen slash commands, and a Stop hook for listener resilience.

plugins.name: agent-bus
plugins.description: Coordinate work across multiple Claude/Codex/Cursor sessions on the same machine via a local SQLite-backed message bus. Register a name, delegate to helpers, get a second opinion, ask specialists by capability, broadcast to channels, track tasks, set agent status, record decisions, and generate final reports. Requires @agent-bus-connect/cli on PATH.
